english.title: Use duty free oil in deliberate contravention of a restriction in the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with the intent that the restrictions imposed by section 10(1) of the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979 should be contravened used oil in contravention of that section
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(1), (5)(a), (7) and (9) of the Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
with intent that restrictions
imposed by s 10(1) Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979
should be contravened
used oil in contravention of that subsection
which provides that no oil in whose case
delivery without payment of duty has been permitted
under s. 9 Hydrocarbon Oil Duties Act 1979
shall be put to a use
not qualifying for relief under that section

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Any oil acquired, or taken into a vehicle, appliance or storage tank as mentioned in section 10(1), or supplied as mentioned in section 10(4) or (5) shall be liable to forfeiture.

other.penalty:
Summary; Six months imprisonment and / or a penalty of £20,000 or of three times the value of the oil in question, whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment or a penalty of any amount..

Time limit for Prosecutions:
None
